name: ephe-template-library
description: Curated, licence-audited local templates for sites, worlds and motion scenes.

commands.name: template-list
commands.template: List the local templates available in Ephe.

commands.name: template-apply
commands.description: Apply an audited template into a local project.

commands.name: template-provenance
commands.description: Explain the licence and hash of one template.
commands.template: Which licence and sha256 does template {{id}} carry?

tools.name: ephe_template_apply
tools.description: Copy an audited template and its licence into a local project.

template_id.description: One of the ids `ephe_template_list` answers with. The copy is refused when the provenance record has no such entry, its licence file is missing, the file's sha256 does not match the record, or the file references a public CDN.

destination.description: Absolute folder the template and its licence file are copied into, created when missing; the template keeps the file name its provenance record names.

changelog: 1.0.0 - first curated offline template pack with audited provenance.
